method: Full pinned file read; Git/SHA256 verification. Executed AST-extracted Runner.replay and on_io_event with synthetic objects/stream. No Gio process, GUI or modification script launched.
findings: Launcher uses spawnv argument arrays, preserving literal path arguments, but appends input paths without explicit -- separator. It changes cwd to temporary directory, so relative input paths require caller normalization.

Runner.run dereferences process even when launcher returns None after GLib error. stderr is not drained during stdout streaming; termination callback only reads4096 bytes after wait failure. Large stderr can stall child before termination; source-level concern not executed.

on_io_event treats empty string and EOF identically, emits process-finished from stream state without synchronizing successful wait callback. Synthetic blank-line control confirms early finish and process reference cleared; actual valid scanner stream impact not reproduced.

replay defaults allowed_paths=None but unconditionally subscribes allowed_paths[path] after condition accepting None. Nonempty valid synthetic report raises TypeError before writing or spawning. It also mutates is_original in original stored objects and sets was_replayed before completion.

on_replay_finish emits success-shaped signal even after wait error, save relies on was_replayed rather than verified outputs. Incomplete/malformed JSON rows are logged and skipped, with no explicit complete-report validation before replay in this module.

Script.run forces -p and -f, silences stderr and signals finished on stream EOF without checking exit status. Script display decodes invalid UTF8 with errors ignored and strips ANSI; displayed paths can lose identity. _fix_shell_auto_remove_path globally text-replaces source path without shell-context escaping.
limits: No complete GUI/process-pipe or generated-script execution.
